info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be delighted , to rejoice , to be happy, to fill with pleasure

info.value: ... kamatolIke tuzwO harzati hfzyati ' (Slo. 176) iti devaH .

examples: 'guruH praharzaH prabaBUva nAtmani' (raGu॰3.17). pravfdDo harzaH SarIre nAmAdityAha.
'taM vicintayataH SApaM praharzaH samajAyata' (BA॰Adi॰125.20). praharzaH kAma iti nIlakaRWaH. upasTendriyotTAnamiti tvApawekozaH.
'uBO paramasaMhfzwO mattAviva mahAgajO' (BA0 vi0 13.27). hfzwalomAnO, kaRwakitagAtrO.
'tasmiMstrivargAnuguRA guROGAH saMharzayogAdiva sannivizwAH' (avadA0 jAta0 2-1). saMharzaH sparDA saMGarzaH.
'te vAhayantastvanyonyaM saMharzAtsahasA drutAH' (hari0 2.14.22). atra saMharzaH sparDeti BAti.
'aTa yaducca hfzyati ni ca hfzyati tadasya mEtrAvaruRaM rUpam' (E0 brA0 3.4). nihfzyati aDo gacCati. jvalato'gnerOnnatyamudDarzaH. jvAlASAntyA nIcatvaM niharza iti sAyaRaH.

'SItenodDfzitasya mAzaSimivaccintArRave majjataH' (rAja0 3.181). udDfzitasya romAYcitasya. anarTaka ucCabdaH, kevalenApi hfzitaSabdena hfzwalomA kaRwakitagAtra ucyate. hfzita iti hfzu alIka ityasya nizWAyAmiwi rUpam.
'kftamudDarzaRaM pUrvaM mayA vaH sIdatAM nfpAH' (BA0 ASrama0 17.1). udDarzaRam utsAhavarDanam.
'udDarzaya maGavannAyuDAnyut satvanAM mAmakAnAM manAMsi' (f0 10.103.10). udDarzaya uccErhfzwAni kuru.
